AT-01.source_scenario: Launch the human interface. Only reading/exploration destinations appear; no authoring modules or controls load.

AT-02.source_scenario: Search a preferred label, alias, exact ID, and words in a definition. Matching is deterministic and relevant.

AT-03.source_scenario: Two entries share a label/alias. Both appear with distinctions; neither is silently selected.

AT-04.source_scenario: Apply category/lifecycle filters to a multi-page result set. Filtering happens before pagination; valid later matches remain reachable.

AT-05.source_scenario: Search returns more matches than one page permits. Continuation is stable, with no duplicate or skipped identities within the same snapshot.

AT-06.source_scenario: A result is omitted by a byte/time/traversal bound. The UI reports incomplete coverage rather than “nothing exists.”

AT-07.source_scenario: Read an entry with definition, aliases, scope note, and examples. Present fields faithfully; omit absent sections without inventing content.

AT-08.source_scenario: Open a deprecated entry by exact ID. Show its status and recorded replacement without silently rewriting history.

AT-09.source_scenario: A draft or inferred record is available under an explicit permitted filter. Its status remains distinct from approved asserted knowledge.

AT-10.source_scenario: Select a graph node. Details change, but the camera and graph focus do not unexpectedly move.

AT-11.source_scenario: Choose Focus here. The neighborhood changes deliberately, and Back restores the prior useful state.

AT-12.source_scenario: Expand a high-degree node. Limits remain enforced and omitted connections are clearly disclosed.

AT-13.source_scenario: Two predicates connect the same endpoints. Both canonical relationship IDs and their meanings remain inspectable.

AT-14.source_scenario: Traverse an incoming relationship. Arrow and sentence retain the canonical subject–predicate–object direction.

AT-15.source_scenario: Render self-loops, cycles, and qualified relationships. No infinite expansion or semantic merging occurs.

AT-16.source_scenario: Switch between map and list. Selection, filters, returned scope, and warnings agree.

AT-17.source_scenario: Open a supported process. Purpose, roles, inputs/outputs, and ordering appear only where supported by the selected source.

AT-18.source_scenario: A process has no recorded step order. Show the gap; do not infer a sequence from graph layout or unrelated relations.

AT-19.source_scenario: Open a definition's or relationship's source. Show the authorized locator/excerpt and evidence status for the correct identity.

AT-20.source_scenario: The source bytes change after the entry loads. Do not present the new bytes as the originally recorded evidence without a warning/version distinction.

AT-21.source_scenario: Canonical inputs change during navigation or publication. Reject mixed-version continuations; refresh the display coherently.

AT-22.source_scenario: A slow response for entry A arrives after selecting B. B remains the current entry.

AT-23.source_scenario: Session expires or service stops. Preserve readable context and desired route; explain reconnection without making unauthorized startup claims.

AT-24.source_scenario: Submit direct browser requests to old write or execution endpoints. They fail; no protected artifacts change.

AT-25.source_scenario: Use invalid Host/Origin/CSRF/session values or another service's credentials. Requests fail without leaking project data.

AT-26.source_scenario: Attempt encoded traversal, absolute-path access, symlink escape, or an unselected source reference. Access is denied.

AT-27.source_scenario: Labels/source text contain HTML, script-like text, or malicious links. They display safely and do not execute.

AT-28.source_scenario: Load the production bundle under the production CSP with no internet. Reader and graph work without remote assets.

AT-29.source_scenario: Complete all major reading tasks by keyboard and via the relationship list. No drag, hover, or canvas-only action is required.

AT-30.source_scenario: Use narrow viewport, browser zoom, reduced motion, and both themes. Text reflows, controls remain operable, and important states remain legible.

AT-31.source_scenario: Browse the root and neutral template, then a separate namespace fixture. No hard-coded project identity, cache leakage, or source crossover occurs.

AT-32.source_scenario: Perform all read workflows with missing optional embedding/RDF services. Core reading works; nothing is installed or started implicitly.

AT-33.source_scenario: Compare protected file hashes/timestamps before and after the read workflow. Ontology, memory, proposals, receipts, and generated products are unchanged.

AT-34.source_scenario: Disable or fail the graph renderer. Definitions, relationship list, and evidence access still work.

AT-35.source_scenario: Run existing agent retrieval, publication/recovery, and template contract tests. No unintended behavioral regression occurs.

AT-36.source_scenario: Measure the representative and stress fixtures. Publish actual timings, memory/limits, and graceful-degradation results rather than assumed performance.

numeric_qualifications.display: REQ-014/018 and D05: depth 1, proposed ~25 nodes/50 edges, proposed cumulative 100 nodes/200 edges within stricter existing limits
numeric_qualifications.agent_limits: REQ-014/033 and D05: defaults 2 hops/20 results, maximums 8 hops/100 results/32000 bytes, inspected 100 visited-node cap retained
numeric_qualifications.visual: D04: proposed rail 224-260 CSS px, lines 65-75 characters, map panel 320-400 px, reading ~16 px, comfort primary controls ~44 px
numeric_qualifications.accessibility: REQ-034/036: WCAG AA 4.5:1 normal contrast, 24x24 CSS px target with exceptions, 320 CSS px reflow test; not compliance claims
numeric_qualifications.search_tuning: D04: roughly 150-200 ms debounce proposed; excluded from warm search target
numeric_qualifications.timing: REQ-045: ~2 s cold first readable screen; p95 200 ms warm search; p95 250 ms entry; ~1.5 s initial graph; 100 ms loaded selection; repeated median/p95 evidence
numeric_qualifications.fixtures: REQ-046: approximately 50/100, 1000/5000, 5000/50000 entries/relationships as suggested synthetic scales
numeric_qualifications.usability: REQ-047: roughly 30 seconds known-term target, not universal or measured

exclusions_and_choices: Out of scope and D01-D08 retain full first-release exclusions and separate implementation choices, authoring/history preservation, source/Template/root adoption, source commands as data, and optional future enhancements.
